'''Laefar''' is an [[Ogier]] from [[Stedding Shangtai]]. {{ref/book|4|16}}

==Activities==

[[Loial]] says that he met Laefar in [[Tear]]. Laefar was in Tear to "negotiate repairs on some Ogier stonework in one of the palaces." He told Loial that the Elders had named him a runaway, and that his mother promised to have him married and settled. Loial does not doubt that Laefar will inform the Elders that he is in Tear.
